Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Record Class ListingSummary

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.ListingSummary
Record Components:
listing - the listing shown
viewer - the role of the user looking at the card
sellerName - the seller's full name, or the username if the account no longer exists
sellerActive - false if the admin deactivated the seller (their listings are hidden from Browse)
available - true if the listing accepts offers, borrow requests and claims (glossary)
claimPending - true if the listing is a giveaway with a pending claim
public record ListingSummary(Listing listing, UserRole viewer, String sellerName, boolean sellerActive, boolean available, boolean claimPending) extends Record
What a listing card shows, worked out once from a listing and the store. The card looks the same in all three portals (non-functional requirement: shared components for cards), and only a few lines change with who is looking:
  • UserRole.BUYER (Browse, UC8 step 2): the availability status, and the card is greyed out when the listing is not available (UC8 Special Requirement 1).
  • UserRole.SELLER (My Listings, Task 2.4): the listing's status; no seller line, because the listings are the seller's own.
  • UserRole.ADMIN (Listing Review, Task 3.2; Manage All Listings, Task 3.7): the status, the seller's username next to the full name, the submitted date and time, and the number of photos.
It also words the listing detail screen (UC8 step 7): fields() and actionText(). All of this is tested in ListingSummaryTest; ListingCard and the detail screen only display it.
